status_definitions.accepted: Implemented and passed the named source, artifact, device, and compatibility evidence.
status_definitions.device-tested: Implemented and passed named device/compatibility checks, but one or more release acceptance gates remain open.
status_definitions.core-ready: Portable protocol or cryptographic core is implemented and tested, but no accepted device workflow exists.
status_definitions.implementation: Active implementation track; must not be advertised by the device or product claims.
status_definitions.blocked: Cannot proceed safely on the current app or hardware boundary.

capabilities.name: USB U2F/CTAP1
capabilities.release_gate: Preserve the v0.1 physical acceptance receipt and repeat it for every changed artifact.
evidence: One-operation lock and management USB restoration
Exact installed FAP read-back hash match

capabilities.name: USB CTAP2.2 transport and commands
capabilities.release_gate: CTAP HID, canonical CBOR, command state machine, PIN/UV, persistence, and conformance tests must pass together.

capabilities.name: Discoverable WebAuthn credentials
capabilities.release_gate: CTAP2 makeCredential/getAssertion, resident-key quotas, credential management, PIN/UV, and browser matrix.

capabilities.name: OpenSSH FIDO-backed keys
capabilities.release_gate: CTAP2 acceptance plus disposable OpenSSH enrollment, signing, reboot, and recovery tests.

capabilities.name: OATH TOTP
capabilities.release_gate: Encrypted vault, safe provisioning, RTC drift UI, approval policy, and on-device RFC 6238 vectors.
evidence: Portable RFC 6238 SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 vectors

capabilities.name: OATH HOTP
capabilities.release_gate: Encrypted counter persistence must be atomic and fail closed before UI release.

capabilities.name: HMAC-SHA-256 challenge-response
capabilities.release_gate: Define a bounded authenticated host transport and require request-bound physical approval.

capabilities.name: PIV smart-card application
capabilities.release_gate: USB CCID/composite firmware path, APDU parser, PIN policy, certificate provisioning, and NIST SP 800-73 test plan.

capabilities.name: OpenPGP card application
capabilities.release_gate: USB CCID/composite firmware path, APDU parser, isolated signing/decryption/authentication keys, and GnuPG interoperability.

capabilities.name: Bluetooth authenticator transport
capabilities.release_gate: Standards-compatible transport, pairing, privacy, downgrade, relay, disconnect, and radio lifecycle review.

capabilities.name: NFC authenticator transport
capabilities.release_gate: Standards-compatible transport and a field-power, relay, privacy, and teardown assessment.

capabilities.name: Encrypted backup and recovery
capabilities.release_gate: Explicit portability policy, authenticated export format, rollback analysis, restore ceremony, and independent recovery authenticator.
